source.title: Larne Times, 5 January 1929, p. 2 ("Larne Urban Elections. A Dearth of Contests")
source.publisher: Larne Times (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Four wards had a single nomination; Gardenmore was polled and the two figures are read from the printed result line.

note: Annual election of five urban councillors, one for each ward, polled 15 January 1929; only Gardenmore Ward was contested (Larne Times, 5 January 1929, p. 2; Belfast News-Letter, 16 January 1929, p. 7). The only nominee in Curran. Returned unopposed.
